messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 — Partial routing spike to west2 after bluepush. Several healthchecks failing, increased 5xx rate. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-routing. Pd: @derek_oncall @sam_sre

derek_oncall: Oncall here, acknowledging. What are the customer-facing symptoms?

sam_sre: Seeing ~12% 5xx for inference API in eu-west, ~30% of traffic is unexpectedly routed to west2 (should be ~5%). Healthchecks for blue instances flapping since 10:06 UTC.

nina_prod: We deployed bluepush at 10:03 UTC. Canary was set to 5% but routing config shows weight drifted during propagation. DNS TTLs are 300s but some edge caches sticky.

lisa_support: CS: two enterprise tenants in EU reporting ~30s timeouts on tokenize/generate endpoints. I'm drafting a short notice.

derek_oncall: Can we pause the rollout or flip the feature flag that controls geo-weighting? Need immediate mitigation.

deploy-bot: Deploy logs: deploy/bluepush/2026-03-17-1003 -> success in west2, but healthcheck flaps 10:07-10:09 (timeout >250ms).

sam_sre: Recommend kill-switch on `region-routing-weight` flag to pin to previous pool. Runbook step 3: disable new-weight. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/region-routing#kill-switch

derek_oncall: Executing kill switch now. Command: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://config-api.internal/flags/region-routing-weight -d '{"value":"pin-old","meta":"pager partial west2"}'`

ops-eng: Also lowering west2 mesh weight as backup: `python infra/scripts/set_weights.py --service inference --region west2 --weight 0` (execing now).

incident-bot: Change recorded: flag-change/4299991111 by derek_oncall at 10:09:12 UTC. Mesh-weight job queued (job-id jw-8821).

nina_prod: Metrics: error rate dropped from 12% -> 2% within 90s after flag flip. Still seeing a tail due to DNS TTL and some clients with cached endpoints.

derek_oncall: Good. Lisa, send customer note: short, honest, ETA on normalization (approx 5-10m).

lisa_support: Message sent to affected tenants & internal CS channel. Summary: 'Mitigating partial routing issue after a regional rollout — rollback in progress. Expect full recovery within 5–10 minutes.' :white_check_mark:

sam_sre: Initiating controlled rollback of west2 canary to previous image as additional safety (rollback-id rr-429999). Kicking at 10:12.

deploy-bot: Rollback started rr-429999 at 10:12:38. Progress: 20% -> 60% -> 100% (10:16).

nina_prod: Post-rollback metrics: latency normalized, 5xx back to baseline (~0.4%) by 10:18. Edge telemetry confirms majority of clients re-resolved to old endpoints.

derek_oncall: Incident mitigation complete. Will follow up with postmortem. Assigning owners: sam_sre, nina_prod. Schedule postmortem and include DNS cache/propagation checks in checklist.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — duration ~14m. Pages cleared. Please ack the pager and file a postmortem ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4299991111 (add timeline + RCA).

sam_sre: Acknowledge. I'll start timeline and include steps to add an automated guard in the rollout orchestration to verify region weights before promoting beyond canary.

nina_prod: Noted. Also propose reducing TTL on rollout-critical records during deployment window to avoid sticky caches.

derek_oncall: Closing oncall. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
